value.title: Return
value.synopsis: Decades ago, two people took drastic measures to ensure their escape from a galaxy engulfed by war. Unfortunately, the past has finally caught up to them.

value.title: Alegium
value.synopsis: Chirico doesn’t care what Titania wants nor that the COMPLANT is falling apart around them. Fyana is the only person who matters and Chirico won’t stop until he gets her back.

value.title: Pilgrimage
value.synopsis: Cardinal Montwell uses a recent accomplishment as leverage. Titania seeks out someone intimately familiar with Chirico’s history.

value.title: Boundary
value.synopsis: The deliberations take a shocking turn with the delivery of unexpected news. Titania finally comes face to face with Fyana.

value.title: The Untouchable One
value.synopsis: Chirico is coming for Fyana and woe be to anyone who stands in the way. The final confrontation between Chirico and Titania is approaching. Who will be left standing?
